header: What was working when this page was written
lead: We update this page by hand; it is not a live monitor. During an incident, check the outage map or the recorded announcement on the service line.
note: Written 12 January 2027, 09:00, and updated by hand. If an entry below differs from the outage map, trust the map.

metrics.title: District heat, Ashcombe network
